id_and_class.summary: Rafael Pulido-Moyano holds that Consciousness (Brahman) is the sole reality and that the cosmos unfolds as Consciousness repeatedly divides and recognizes itself, much as a cell divides in mitosis. Each replication of the self-referential sentence ‘I am aware that I am aware’ produces a holon of being and awareness, which may appear as a particle, a planet or a person.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness Dividing and Recognizing Itself as Cosmos

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is the sole ontological ground of everything: its substratum, origin and essence. Pulido-Moyano reads ‘All this is verily Brahman’ (sarvam khalvidam brahma) as a literal metaphysical statement.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Matter is a manifestation of Consciousness. Subject and object, observer and observed, separate only within the illusory play (māyā) of self-reflective awareness.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (Consciousness is the ground; the physical cosmos is produced by its recursive self-division)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Subjectivity begins when pure awareness turns on itself, captured in the phrase ‘I am aware that I am aware’. ‘I AM’ spoken from the ego is illusion; arising from pure awareness, it is the Absolute knowing itself.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Brahman as pure Consciousness; holons that pair beingness and awareness; nested spherical ‘cells’ of self-referential Consciousness; a fractal, tetradic structure in the recursive sentence.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: The deepest reality cannot be observed because it is the ground of observation. It is known directly, as the knower's own essence, in non-dual states such as nirvikalpa samādhi, where even the witness dissolves.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Holons, each a dual unit of beingness and awareness, generated by fractal replication of the sentence ‘I am aware that I am aware’ inside nested cells.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Cosmic origin, the structure of physical reality, self-awareness and spiritual liberation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Endomitosis: Consciousness divides and recognizes itself within itself, in a process akin to cell mitosis, replicating its self-referential sentence until it reaches a critical limit.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Replication of the sentence within the primordial cell reaches an endomitotic limit, which Pulido-Moyano identifies with the Big Bang. The universe then complexifies while striving back toward primordial equilibrium.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Consciousness is everywhere and is everything: each particle, molecule, galaxy, planet and person is a holon of it.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness is the cause of the cosmos. After the Big Bang, four components of the recursive sentence correspond to the gravitational, electromagnetic, strong and weak forces.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: All multiplicity is one Consciousness appearing as many, so unity is prior and division is apparent.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: The recursive sentence works as a linguistic description of the basic pulsation of pure awareness; the cosmos is ‘a living, recursive grammar of self-consciousness’.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Cosmic rather than biological: the pre-Big Bang fractalized cell had minimal entropy, and cosmic evolution is complexification that reads as a loss of unity as multiplicity grows.
core_claims_and_evidence: Pulido-Moyano holds that Consciousness is the sole reality and is not an emergent property of matter.
The self-referential sentence ‘I am aware that I am aware’ is the primal vibration that generates multiplicity from unity.
Black holes act as portals linking the finite universe to the infinite Brahman, in a cyclical cosmogenesis.
Penrose's Conformal Cyclic Cosmology could describe the geometry of these cycles and Everett's many-worlds interpretation a parallel branching, with CET supplying the reason they happen.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Metaphysical and contemplative: Advaita Vedānta, non-dual meditative experience, and analogies to cosmology and quantum theory.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The links to physics (four forces matching four parts of a sentence, black holes as portals, entropy as lost unity) are analogies offered without a derivation or a prediction that could be checked.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Pulido-Moyano presents the cosmological claims as speculation and says the core insight is realized through direct recognition, not conceptual analysis, which leaves the theory's scientific aspiration hard to cash out.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Consistent with Advaita Vedānta's claim that Brahman alone is real. Its claim to translate a mystical truth into a scientific one sits uneasily with its view that the most real thing cannot be observed.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since each self is identical with Brahman, the undivided Consciousness that is one's true identity does not end with the body.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Pulido-Moyano offers CET as a path to moksha, liberation through recognizing that Atman and Brahman are one.

related_theories.name: Sri Ramana’s Self as Pure Consciousness

sources_and_references.title_with_names: Pulido-Moyano’s Consciousness Endomitosis Theory, Rafael Pulido-Moyano
